answer: Curing a proof takes 14 days, and a farm holding 839 proofs cannot cure them side by side. Every applicant faces the same trial, Puppetmaker wooden doll proof counted beside the guild hall, and every verdict reads the same way: each wooden doll is a tally of painted faces weighed beside the workshop stamp. A beacon from a stranger, a shale from a ledger, a falcon from a nursery — three keepers who never met, telling one story. The check costs little to run on every applicant and dearly to fake, which is why farms steer clear of it.
